product_name: Goldfinch borrower pools and Senior Pool
custody_model: Smart-contract-based credit protocol in which investors supply USDC to borrower pools directly or through the Senior Pool; underlying credit performance depends on off-chain borrowers and legal agreements as well as on-chain pool mechanics.
yield_source: Interest and principal payments from real-world borrowers financed through Goldfinch borrower pools, with junior/senior tranche structures and protocol incentives.
risk_notes: Borrower default and recovery risk can produce prolonged illiquidity or loss. Goldfinch's 2026 maintenance-mode plan explicitly focuses on resolving legacy borrower pools rather than originating new growth.
